coordinates.scad: Right handed: X right, Y up, +Z towards magnets in assembled cap; angles CCW from +X.
coordinates.kicad: F.Cu faces magnets. X right, Y down; KiCad origin of reducer axis is (100,100).
coordinates.front_rotation: KiCad +9 degree footprint rotation is CCW in front view; no XY mirror is used.
coordinates.important: SCAD housing mirror([0,0,1]) flips Z only, leaving XY unchanged.

inner_sensor_relief_proposal.required_for: TI recommended 1.10 x 0.60 mm lands; original inner pad edge clearance is only 0.17023 mm.
inner_sensor_relief_proposal.transition: Linear radius ramp from original21.6 to21.3 over2 degrees at each end.
inner_sensor_relief_proposal.status: Active: included in outline.edges, polygon, edge_segments and SCAD profile.

narrow_zones.notes: Do not put back-side components under R27: bearing occupies that region. Front components other than sensors need lid pocket verification. Keep mounting heads and M3 fastener volumes free.

tmag5273_source.pin1: Top left at footprint0degrees. Pins1,2,3 run top-to-bottom onleft;6,5,4 top-to-bottom onright.
